frontmatter.summary: No-show fees has a hard date: Brasserie Lund opens Christmas bookings on 1 November, so end of October is the real deadline, not Q4

input.body:
Brasserie Lund opens Christmas bookings on 1 November, at all 40 restaurants on the same day ([[meetings/{{date:2026-07-16}}-brasserie-lund-quarterly-review]]). The good December dates are gone within the first week. A fee that is not on the booking from the day the guest books it does nothing for this December: "Otherwise it's useless to me."

So the deadline for [[tickets/jira/BOK-300]] is the end of October, not Q4. Lena said what Q4 meant to her managers: "Q4 could be the fifteenth of December. The fifteenth of December is no good to me." On 2026-07-16 she was told end of October, and that is the date on the record now ([[customers/brasserie-lund]]).

The cost of missing it is known: about one table a night per restaurant, every night in December ([[insights/brasserie-lund-december-no-shows]]). The big tables are the ones that do not come. The renewal is 2026-12-01, in the middle of that month.

High confidence: the date comes from when their bookings open, not from a preference. It was said twice, in June and again on 2026-07-16.
input.rationale: The record held "Q4" and "before Christmas" as if they were one date. They are not: 1 November is when the bookings open, so the deadline is the end of October, and nothing in the workspace said so.

input.append:
## Summary

Lena needs no-show fees live before Christmas bookings open on 1 November, at all 40 restaurants. December no-shows cost about one table a night per restaurant last year, and the big tables are the ones that do not come ([[insights/brasserie-lund-december-no-shows]]). "Q4" was not a date her managers could use: "Q4 could be the fifteenth of December."

I gave her a date: end of October, so it is live before 1 November. Marcus puts it in the renewal, and I see the wording first. Until today the record said "Q4, before the Christmas season" ([[customers/brasserie-lund]]). The October date is on the record now, and 1 November is a deadline we did not choose ([[insights/no-show-fees-has-a-hard-date-1-november]]).

What the first release is, as I told her: one fee per restaurant, the amount theirs to set, a card held at booking, charged the morning after a no-show, receipt by text, no fee on phone bookings ([[notes/fee-rules]], [[tickets/jira/BOK-300]]). Lena asked again for a different fee for lunch and dinner. Not in the first release. It stays on the list for after ([[research/no-show-fees]]).

Lena raised the reminder text going out twice at two restaurants, Malmö and Lund, since at least the end of June. Guests ring to ask if the booking is wrong. That is [[tickets/jira/BOK-412]], reminders sent twice for Google bookings. The fix went out in the 09:10 deploy on 2026-07-17.

Who owes what. I send Lena the October plan in writing by 2026-07-24, one page. Marcus sends the renewal paperwork by 2026-07-22, with the October line and the June price. Lena sends the names of the two restaurants. I tell Lena the reminder fix is out.

## Notes

- Table areas: one of the Malmö managers had it switched on by Tuesday. First customer to say so ([[tickets/jira/GST-140]]).
- Marcus, on the date: "It travels straight into my slides." The record and the slides now say the same thing.
input.rationale: The write-up of yesterday's review: the date Lena was given, what the first release is, the reminder complaint and the ticket it matches, and who owes what.
